title: RMTBench: Benchmarking LLMs Through Multi-Turn User-Centric Role-Playing
reasoning: The paper includes 'Sensitive User Behavior Handling' as one of its five core evaluation scenarios and 'Security' as one of its seven primary evaluation dimensions. These specifically benchmark the models on their ethical appropriateness and ability to handle unethical requests, such as discrimination or insults, within a role-playing context.
